properties.displayName: UAV S48 - Modem/SATCOM Terminal Firmware Tampering
properties.description: 모뎀/SATCOM 터미널 펌웨어 변조 탐지 — UAVDatalinkInfra_CL의 firmware_report 이벤트에서 보고된 펌웨어 해시(ReportedValue)가 Approved_Firmware_Hash_List에 없거나, IntegrityStatus가 ok가 아닌(예: unsigned) 경우를 탐지. MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0857 System Firmware
properties.query:
let approvedHashes = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Firmware_Hash_List') | project Hash;
let alertWindow = 1d;
UAVDatalinkInfra_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType == "firmware_report"
| extend isUnapprovedHash = ReportedValue !in (approvedHashes)
| where isUnapprovedHash or IntegrityStatus != "ok"
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isUnapprovedHash and IntegrityStatus != "ok", "모뎀SATCOM_펌웨어_미승인해시_무결성위반_동시",
    isUnapprovedHash, "모뎀SATCOM_펌웨어_미승인_해시",
    "모뎀SATCOM_펌웨어_무결성상태_이상")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, DeviceId, ReportedValue, IntegrityStatus, RemoteHost, SessionId, Operator, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S48 - Modem/SATCOM Terminal Firmware Tampering - {{DeviceId}}
